added_results.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT * FROM spans WHERE "start_time" >= ?::TIMESTAMP_NS::TIMESTAMPTZ_NS AND "start_time" < ?::TIMESTAMP_NS::TIMESTAMPTZ_NS AND ((service = 'checkout')) AND ((namespace = 'shop'))) SELECT epoch_ms(time_bucket(INTERVAL '300 seconds', "start_time"::TIMESTAMP_NS))::BIGINT AS "_t", quantile_cont("duration_ms", 0.95)::DOUBLE AS "p95" FROM base GROUP BY time_bucket(INTERVAL '300 seconds', "start_time"::TIMESTAMP_NS) ORDER BY "_t" LIMIT 18000

WITH base AS (SELECT * FROM spans WHERE "start_time" >= ?::TIMESTAMP_NS::TIMESTAMPTZ_NS AND "start_time" < ?::TIMESTAMP_NS::TIMESTAMPTZ_NS) SELECT epoch_ms(time_bucket(INTERVAL '30 seconds', "start_time"::TIMESTAMP_NS))::BIGINT AS "_t", count(*)::DOUBLE AS "count" FROM base GROUP BY time_bucket(INTERVAL '30 seconds', "start_time"::TIMESTAMP_NS) ORDER BY "_t" LIMIT 14000
